title: Remind members two days before a loan is due
body:
Closes #30.

The nightly job now sends a "Due soon" email two days before a loan's due date, then the overdue reminders as before.
head: due-soon-reminders
author: readwell-dev

issues.title: Remind members before a loan is due
issues.body: Members keep forgetting due dates and end up overdue. Send them a reminder email two days before a loan is due, from the nightly job.

comments.author: assist-bot
comments.body: `isAlmostLate` doesn't check `loan.returnedAt`. A member who returns a copy early still gets the "Due soon" email two days before the old due date, because `sendReminders` calls `isAlmostLate` for every loan in `db.loans`. `isOverdue` guards against this with `!loan.returnedAt`; this check should too.

comments.author: review-bot
comments.body:
**Potential issue (major): `addDays` mutates `now`, shifting every later date check by two days.**

`addDays(now, 2)` moves the caller's `now` forward. `sendReminders` passes the same `now` to `isOverdue` and to the `daysOver` math right after this call, so overdue reminders are computed two days in the future.

```suggestion
  const twoDaysOut = addDays(new Date(now.getTime()), 2);
```

comments.author: volunteer-dev
comments.body: Email is easy to miss for something time-sensitive like this. Could we send the due-soon reminder as an SMS instead? Most members gave us a phone number at the desk.

comments.author: review-bot
comments.body:
**Refactor suggestion (minor): make the reminder lead time configurable.**

Hard-coding two days ties policy to code. Read the lead time from configuration (for example a `REMINDER_LEAD_DAYS` environment variable, or a per-member preference) so the library can tune it without a deploy.

comments.author: desk-lead
comments.body: Should members be able to opt out of these? A few people complained about the overdue emails last month.

reviews.author: review-bot
reviews.body:
**2 inline comments posted.**

<details>
<summary>Comments on lines outside the diff (1)</summary>

`src/loans.js` lines 7-36: **Prefer arrow functions for the exported helpers.** `checkOut`, `renew`, `giveBack` and `isOverdue` use function declarations; switch them to `export const checkOut = (...) => { ... }` for consistency with modern JavaScript style.

</details>

reviews.author: assist-bot
reviews.body:
## Overview

This PR adds a due-soon email that the nightly job sends two days before a loan's due date. Reviewed 4 of 4 changed files and left 1 comment.

comments.author: review-bot
comments.body:
## Summary of changes

The nightly job now emails members two days before a loan is due, using a new `isAlmostLate` helper in `src/loans.js`.

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/loans.js` | Adds `isAlmostLate`. |
| `src/reminders.js` | Sends a "Due soon" email before the overdue checks. |
| `test/loans.test.js` | Tests the due-soon email. |
